spec.title: Do the robustness-formulation results from the truss transfer to the manipulator (peak torque under +/- 2 % link and radius tolerance)?
spec.hypothesis: As on the truss, the converged nominal torque optimum loses feasibility under tolerance because the tip-deflection limit binds; post-hoc selection along the trajectory and a measured margin recover 95 % robustness for a few per cent of torque, and copy-based constraints are budget-starved at equal solver calls.
